summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Department notice for non-compliance with listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to late filing of its Form 20-F for FY2025. There were no special-situation corporate actions such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. The event is a routine delisting risk disclosure with a compliance plan deadline of July 19, 2026, and a potential extension. No deal terms apply.
